truth.description: invalidateModule hard-invalidates an importer only when the changed file is in importer.pluginWatchedFiles, whose only producer is importAnalysis, which skips CSS requests, while css.ts registers each @import dependency of a CSS module through updateModuleInfo, so for a CSS importer the guard is always false and editing an @imported stylesheet soft-invalidates the importing CSS module, which is then served with its stale compiled CSS.

distractions.why: A module already seen is walked again only when its invalidation state changed, and a state can only move from soft to hard once, so the recursion still ends.
